name: Sprint 3 Integration - Full Ticket Lifecycle Across All Actors
description:
As the SCMS-AI team
I want one ticket to go through every actor and status using the real web routes
So that the Sprint 1, 2 and 3 features are shown to work together

elements.name: A citizen report goes from submission to rating (Happy Path)

steps.name: the demo data is loaded
the citizen "0812xxxxxxx" submits a report with photo "jalan_berlubang_integrasi.jpg" at "Jl. Kalijudan No. 99, Surabaya"
a new ticket is created with status "Dilaporkan" and priority "Tinggi"
the citizen sees the unread notification count go up by 1
the admin approves the new ticket
the ticket status is "Disetujui"
the admin assigns road inspector "Budi Santoso" to the new ticket
the ticket status is "Ditugaskan"
the inspector saves the inspection with damage level "Sedang" and recommendation "Tambal Hotmix"
the ticket status is "Terinspeksi" and its Risk Score is recalculated to 5.5 "Borderline"
the admin issues SPK "SPK/PUPR/XI/2026/099" to team "Satgas Rayon Gubeng"
the ticket status is "Dalam Proses"
the inspector completes the repair with a proof photo
the ticket status is "Selesai"
the citizen's timeline shows every stage as done
the citizen received exactly one notification for each status change
every notification was delivered
the citizen rates the repair 5 stars with review "Cepat dan rapi"
the rating is saved and the report can no longer be rated
the performance report for today counts 1 incoming and 1 completed ticket in its charts and tables

elements.name: A rejected report is closed with a reason (Negative Path)

steps.name: the demo data is loaded
the citizen "0812xxxxxxx" submits a report with photo "jalan_retak_integrasi.jpg" at "Jl. Kertajaya Indah No. 7, Surabaya"
a new ticket is created with status "Dilaporkan" and priority "Borderline"
the admin rejects the new ticket with reason "Di luar kewenangan DPUPR"
the ticket status is "Ditutup"
the citizen's newest notification mentions "Di luar kewenangan DPUPR"
the citizen cannot rate the closed report
the performance report for today lists the ticket under closed reason "Di luar kewenangan DPUPR" without charts

name: Reporting Road Damage
description:
In order to kondisi jalan rusak di lingkungan saya segera ditangani oleh dinas terkait
As a Warga
I want to membuat laporan kerusakan jalan dengan mengunggah foto, lokasi, dan deskripsi

elements.name: Valid Report Successfully Submitted

steps.name: I am logged in and on the "Buat Laporan" page
I upload a road damage photo "jalan_berlubang_dharmawangsa.jpg" (size 2.4MB)
I select the location "Jl. Dharmawangsa No. 20, Surabaya" via GPS
I see the AI category recommendation "Jalan Berlubang" and keep it as is
I enter the description "Lubang besar di tengah jalan membahayakan pengendara motor"
I press the "Kirim Laporan" button
I receive a new ticket number with initial status "Dilaporkan"

elements.name: Photo Fails Format or Size Validation

steps.name: I am on the "Buat Laporan" page
I upload a file with size 15MB or in ".pdf" format
I see the error message "Format harus JPG/PNG dan ukuran maksimal 10MB"
I cannot proceed to the next step

elements.name: Photo Not Recognised as Road Damage Goes to Manual Review

steps.name: I am on the "Buat Laporan" page
I upload a photo that does not show road damage, such as "kucing.jpg"
I see the notice "Perlu tinjauan manual"
my report is saved with status "Dilaporkan" and marked for manual review

elements.name: Report Detected as a Duplicate

steps.name: there is already an active report "REP-2026-00298" at "Jl. Sudirman No. 45" with category "Jalan Berlubang"
I submit a new report at the same location with a similar description
my report is merged into ticket "REP-2026-00298" and its exposure count increases by 1
I receive the notification "Laporan Anda telah digabungkan dengan laporan serupa yang sudah aktif (REP-2026-00298)"

name: UC-A Report with a Photo the AI Cannot Classify
description:
As a Warga
I want my report to be accepted even when the AI does not recognise the damage in my valid photo
So that real damage is still handled after an officer reviews it manually

elements.name: Valid photo without AI detection is accepted for manual review (Happy Path)

steps.name: I am logged in and on the "Buat Laporan" page
I upload a valid road photo "tanpa_deteksi_jl_kenjeran.jpg" in which the AI detects nothing
I see the notice "Perlu tinjauan manual"
I can proceed to the next step
I select the location "Jl. Kenjeran No. 100, Surabaya" via GPS
I choose the category "Jalan Berlubang" myself
I enter the description "Aspal mengelupas dan berlubang di depan pasar"
I press the "Kirim Laporan" button
I receive a new ticket number with initial status "Dilaporkan"
the new ticket is labelled "Perlu tinjauan manual" in the Verifikasi queue

elements.name: Photo that looks like a non-road object goes to manual review (Revised Sprint 1 Path)

steps.name: I am logged in and on the "Buat Laporan" page
I upload a valid photo that does not show road damage, such as "kucing.jpg"
I do not see the warning "Objek jalan rusak tidak terdeteksi, silakan ambil ulang foto"
I see the notice "Perlu tinjauan manual"
I complete the location, category and description steps and press the "Kirim Laporan" button
I receive a new ticket number with initial status "Dilaporkan"
the new ticket is labelled "Perlu tinjauan manual" in the Verifikasi queue

elements.name: Manual-review ticket is treated as an ambiguous score and can be rejected (Happy Path)

steps.name: a ticket labelled "Perlu tinjauan manual" with status "Dilaporkan" reported by citizen "0812xxxxxxx"
the admin opens the ticket on the Verifikasi page
I see the options "Tugaskan Inspeksi Tambahan", "Lanjutkan Tanpa Inspeksi" and "Tolak"
I do not see the "Setujui Tiket" button
the Dashboard quick-approve of that ticket is rejected
the admin presses the "Tolak" button and closes the ticket with reason "Laporan tidak valid"
I see the ticket status change to "Ditutup"
the citizen "0812xxxxxxx" receives a notification containing "Laporan tidak valid"

elements.name: Invalid file is still rejected under BR-1 (Negative Path)

steps.name: I am on the "Buat Laporan" page
I upload a file named "tanpa_deteksi.pdf" that is not a real JPEG or PNG image
I see the error message "Format harus JPG/PNG dan ukuran maksimal 10MB"
I cannot proceed to the next step

name: Verifying Damage Reports
description:
In order to memastikan hanya laporan valid yang diteruskan ke proses penugasan
As a Admin
I want to memverifikasi laporan kerusakan

elements.name: Admin Approves a Ticket

steps.name: I open ticket "REP-2026-00341" with Risk Score "8.4 (Urgent)"
I press the "Setujui Tiket" button
I see the ticket status change to "Disetujui"

elements.name: Ticket with Ambiguous Risk Score

steps.name: I open ticket "REP-2026-00355" with Risk Score "5.1 (Borderline)"
I view the ticket detail
I see the option "Butuh Verifikasi Lapangan"

elements.name: Admin Assigns Additional Inspection

steps.name: I see ticket "REP-2026-00355" marked "Butuh Verifikasi Lapangan"
I select "Tugaskan Inspeksi Tambahan" and assign Penilik Jalan "Budi Santoso"
I see the ticket status change to "Menunggu Inspeksi"

elements.name: Admin Proceeds Without Additional Inspection

steps.name: I see ticket "REP-2026-00355" marked as ambiguous
I press the "Lanjutkan Tanpa Inspeksi" button
I see my decision logged as "Log Keputusan Manual - admin@dpupr.surabaya.go.id"

name: UC-B Close a Ticket with a Mandatory Reason
description:
As a PUPR Admin
I want to close tickets that do not need repair, always stating the reason
So that invalid or out-of-scope reports leave the queue and the citizen knows why

elements.name: Admin rejects a report during verification (Happy Path)

steps.name: the admin opens ticket "REP-2026-00341" of report "LAP-2026-0001" with status "Dilaporkan"
the admin presses the "Tolak" button
the admin selects the closing reason "Laporan tidak valid"
the admin confirms with the "Tutup Tiket" button
I see the ticket status change to "Ditutup"
the status history of "REP-2026-00341" contains "Ditutup: Laporan tidak valid"
the citizen "0812xxxxxxx" receives a notification containing "Laporan tidak valid"
the citizen cannot submit a rating for report "LAP-2026-0001"

elements.name: Closing a ticket without a reason is rejected (Negative Path)

steps.name: the admin opens ticket "REP-2026-00341" of report "LAP-2026-0001" with status "Dilaporkan"
the admin presses the "Tolak" button
the admin confirms with the "Tutup Tiket" button without selecting a closing reason
the system displays a warning message "Pilih alasan penutupan tiket"
the ticket "REP-2026-00341" keeps the status "Dilaporkan"

elements.name: Inspector recommends closing and the admin confirms (Happy Path)

steps.name: the road inspector opens report details for "LAP-2026-0002" with status "Ditugaskan"
the road inspector selects recommendation "Rekomendasikan Tutup" with reason "Sudah diperbaiki pihak lain"
the road inspector selects damage level "Ringan"
the road inspector uploads survey photo "survei_0298.jpg" and clicks the "Simpan Hasil Inspeksi" button
the system updates the report status of "LAP-2026-0002" to "Terinspeksi"
the admin opens the Work Order "REP-2026-00298"
the admin sees the inspector recommendation "Rekomendasi penilik: tutup tiket (Sudah diperbaiki pihak lain)"
the "Terbitkan SPK" button is not available while the recommendation is pending
the admin presses the "Konfirmasi Tutup Tiket" button
the ticket "REP-2026-00298" has status "Ditutup"
the citizen "0813xxxxxxx" receives a notification containing "Sudah diperbaiki pihak lain"

elements.name: Admin rejects the closing recommendation and continues to the SPK (Alternative Path)

steps.name: ticket "REP-2026-00298" is "Terinspeksi" with an inspector recommendation to close for reason "Tidak ditemukan kerusakan"
the admin opens the Work Order "REP-2026-00298"
the admin presses the "Tolak Rekomendasi" button
the ticket "REP-2026-00298" keeps the status "Terinspeksi"
the status history of "REP-2026-00298" contains "Rekomendasi tutup ditolak Admin"
the SPK form with button "Terbitkan SPK" is available for "REP-2026-00298"

name: UC-C Track Citizen Report Status
description:
As a citizen of Surabaya who has reported road damage
I want to track the status and progress history of my report
So that I can transparently know the progress of the road repair

elements.name: Citizen successfully views report progress and timeline (Happy Path)

steps.name: the citizen has accessed the "Riwayat & Lacak Laporan" page
a registered report with ID "LAP-2026-0001" exists for the citizen
the citizen searches for report ID "LAP-2026-0001"
the system displays the report details along with the AI severity score and priority level
the system displays the current progress timeline for report "LAP-2026-0001"

elements.name: Report ticket ID not found (Negative Path)

steps.name: the citizen is on the report tracking page
the citizen enters unregistered report ID "LAP-9999-XXXX"
the system rejects the search
the system displays an error message "Nomor tiket laporan tidak ditemukan, periksa kembali ID Laporan Anda"

name: UC-D Manage Region and Road Inspector Master Data
description:
As a PUPR Admin
I want to manage Rayon Region master data and Road Inspector data
So that every road damage report can be distributed to the correct rayon and officer

elements.name: Admin successfully adds a new Road Inspector data (Happy Path)

steps.name: the admin opens the "Data Master (Wilayah & Penilik Jalan)" page
the admin inputs NIP "199005122022031005", name "Budi Santoso", and selects region "Wilayah Gubeng"
the admin clicks the "Simpan Data" button
the system saves the new Road Inspector data to the database
the system displays a confirmation message "Data master berhasil diperbarui"

elements.name: Failed to save due to duplicate NIP or Region Code (Negative Path)

steps.name: the admin opens the "Data Master (Wilayah & Penilik Jalan)" page
NIP "198501012015021001" is already registered in the system
the admin enters NIP "198501012015021001" on the add Road Inspector form
the admin clicks the "Simpan Data" button
the system rejects saving the master data
the system displays an error message "Kode Wilayah atau NIP Penilik Jalan sudah terdaftar di sistem"

name: UC-E Record Field Inspection by Road Inspector
description:
As a PUPR Road Inspector assigned to a specific rayon area
I want to record field physical survey results on reports assigned to me by the Admin
So that the PUPR Admin has valid technical field data before issuing a Work Order

elements.name: Road Inspector successfully saves field inspection results (Happy Path)

steps.name: the road inspector opens report details for "LAP-2026-0001" with status "Ditugaskan"
the road inspector inputs damage dimensions "2m x 1.5m x 0.15m"
the road inspector inputs technical notes "Lapisan aspal terkelupas dan tergenang air"
the road inspector selects treatment recommendation "Tambal Hotmix" and uploads survey photo "survei_0001.jpg"
the road inspector clicks the "Simpan Hasil Inspeksi" button
the system saves the data to the Inspection table
the system updates the report status of "LAP-2026-0001" to "Terinspeksi"
the system generates an automatic notification for the reporting citizen

elements.name: Incomplete inspection form upon submission (Negative Path)

steps.name: the road inspector opens report details for "LAP-2026-0001" with status "Ditugaskan"
the road inspector leaves mandatory fields like damage dimensions or recommendations blank
the road inspector clicks the "Simpan Hasil Inspeksi" button
the system aborts saving the inspection data
the system displays a warning message "Lengkapi dimensi kerusakan dan rekomendasi teknis penanganan"

name: UC-E Recalculate Risk Score from Field Inspection
description:
As a PUPR Road Inspector assigned to a ticket
I want to confirm the damage category and choose the field damage level during inspection
So that the ticket priority reflects the real condition on site instead of only the AI estimate

elements.name: Field damage level lowers the Risk Score and priority (Happy Path)

steps.name: the road inspector opens report details for "LAP-2026-0002" with status "Ditugaskan"
the ticket "REP-2026-00298" has Risk Score "8.0" with priority "Urgent"
the road inspector confirms the category "Jalan Berlubang"
the road inspector selects damage level "Ringan"
the road inspector fills in the remaining inspection fields and uploads survey photo "survei_0298.jpg"
the road inspector clicks the "Simpan Hasil Inspeksi" button
the system updates the report status of "LAP-2026-0002" to "Terinspeksi"
the ticket "REP-2026-00298" has Risk Score "5.5" with priority "Borderline"
the ticket keeps the AI severity "8.0" for comparison next to the field severity "3"
the status history of "REP-2026-00298" contains "Risk Score diperbarui 8.0 → 5.5 berdasarkan inspeksi"

elements.name: Field damage level raises the priority and the map colour follows (Happy Path)

steps.name: the road inspector opens report details for "LAP-2026-0002" with status "Ditugaskan"
the road inspector confirms the category "Jalan Berlubang"
the road inspector selects damage level "Sangat Berat"
the road inspector fills in the remaining inspection fields and uploads survey photo "survei_0298.jpg"
the road inspector clicks the "Simpan Hasil Inspeksi" button
the ticket "REP-2026-00298" has Risk Score "8.5" with priority "Urgent"
the priority badge of "REP-2026-00298" on the Dashboard uses the colour of priority "Urgent"

elements.name: Inspection without a damage level is rejected (Negative Path)

steps.name: the road inspector opens report details for "LAP-2026-0002" with status "Ditugaskan"
the road inspector confirms the category "Jalan Berlubang"
the road inspector leaves the damage level empty
the road inspector fills in the remaining inspection fields and uploads survey photo "survei_0298.jpg"
the road inspector clicks the "Simpan Hasil Inspeksi" button
the system aborts saving the inspection data
the system displays a warning message "Pilih tingkat kerusakan hasil inspeksi lapangan"
the ticket "REP-2026-00298" still has Risk Score "8.0" with priority "Urgent"

elements.name: Damage level is optional only when no damage is found (Boundary Path)

steps.name: the road inspector opens report details for "LAP-2026-0002" with status "Ditugaskan"
the road inspector selects recommendation "Rekomendasikan Tutup" with reason "Tidak ditemukan kerusakan"
the road inspector leaves the damage level empty
the road inspector uploads survey photo "survei_0298.jpg" and clicks the "Simpan Hasil Inspeksi" button
the inspection result is "Terinspeksi"
the ticket "REP-2026-00298" still has Risk Score "8.0" with priority "Urgent"

elements.id: test_damage_level_is_optional_only_when_no_damage_is_found_boundary_path[Sudah diperbaiki pihak lain-Pilih tingkat kerusakan hasil inspeksi lapangan]
elements.name: Damage level is optional only when no damage is found (Boundary Path)

steps.name: the road inspector opens report details for "LAP-2026-0002" with status "Ditugaskan"
the road inspector selects recommendation "Rekomendasikan Tutup" with reason "Sudah diperbaiki pihak lain"
the road inspector leaves the damage level empty
the road inspector uploads survey photo "survei_0298.jpg" and clicks the "Simpan Hasil Inspeksi" button
the inspection result is "Pilih tingkat kerusakan hasil inspeksi lapangan"
the ticket "REP-2026-00298" still has Risk Score "8.0" with priority "Urgent"

name: UC-E Record a New Finding During Inspection
description:
As a PUPR Road Inspector on site
I want to record other damage I find around the inspected location
So that it becomes a new ticket without waiting for a citizen to report it

elements.name: Inspector records a new finding that becomes a new ticket (Happy Path)

steps.name: the road inspector opens report details for "LAP-2026-0002" with status "Ditugaskan"
the road inspector opens the "Catat Temuan Baru" form
the road inspector uploads finding photo "temuan_sudirman_80.jpg"
the road inspector selects finding category "Retak Permukaan"
the road inspector enters finding description "Retak memanjang di bahu jalan sekitar 3 meter"
the road inspector marks the finding point "-7.26700, 112.74950" on the map
the road inspector clicks the "Simpan Temuan" button
the system creates a new ticket with source "Temuan Penilik" and status "Dilaporkan"
the new report has no reporting citizen and is recorded by road inspector "Budi Santoso"
the new ticket appears in the Verifikasi queue
the ticket "REP-2026-00298" keeps the status "Ditugaskan"
no citizen notification is created for the new ticket

elements.name: Citizen report merged into a finding ticket gets notifications (Alternative Path)

steps.name: a finding ticket with source "Temuan Penilik" and category "Retak Permukaan" exists at "-7.26700, 112.74950" with status "Dilaporkan"
the citizen "0812xxxxxxx" submits a "Retak Permukaan" report at the same point with a similar description
the citizen report is merged into the finding ticket
the citizen "0812xxxxxxx" receives the notification "Laporan digabungkan"
the admin approves the finding ticket
the citizen "0812xxxxxxx" receives a status notification for the finding ticket

elements.name: Finding close to an active ticket is merged by BR-3 deduplication (Alternative Path)

steps.name: the road inspector opens report details for "LAP-2026-0002" with status "Ditugaskan"
the road inspector records a finding with category "Jalan Berlubang" at point "-7.27975, 112.76185" with photo "temuan_kertajaya.jpg"
the road inspector clicks the "Simpan Temuan" button
no new ticket is created
the finding is merged into ticket "REP-2026-00341"
the system displays the message "Temuan digabungkan dengan tiket aktif REP-2026-00341"

elements.name: Finding without a photo is rejected (Negative Path)

steps.name: the road inspector opens report details for "LAP-2026-0002" with status "Ditugaskan"
the road inspector fills in the finding category, description and map point without uploading a photo
the road inspector clicks the "Simpan Temuan" button
the system displays a warning message "Foto temuan wajib diunggah"
no new ticket is created

name: UC-F Update Field Repair Status (Work Order)
description:
As a PUPR Admin or Field Execution Team
I want to issue a Work Order and update the road repair progress status up to Completed
So that the road damage handling cycle is recorded thoroughly and accountably

elements.name: Issuing a Work Order and updating status to Processing (Happy Path)

steps.name: report "LAP-2026-0001" has the status "Terinspeksi"
the admin issues a Work Order with SPK number "SPK/PUPR/XI/2026/001" and team "Satgas Rayon Gubeng"
the admin selects the progress status "Dalam Proses"
the system saves the data to the WorkOrder table
the system updates the status of report "LAP-2026-0001" to "Dalam Proses"
the system sends a status update notification to the reporting citizen

elements.name: Completing road repair with completion proof photo upload (Happy Path)

steps.name: report "LAP-2026-0001" is in "Dalam Proses" status on the active Work Order list
the officer selects progress status "Selesai"
the officer inputs completion notes "Lubang sudah ditambal aspal hotmix dan dipadatkan"
the officer uploads repair proof photo "selesai_0001.jpg"
the officer clicks the "Perbarui Status Penanganan" button
the system updates the WorkOrder status and report status of "LAP-2026-0001" to "Selesai"
the system sends a completion notification to the reporting citizen

elements.name: Updating status to Completed without repair proof photo (Negative Path)

steps.name: report "LAP-2026-0001" is in "Dalam Proses" status on the active Work Order list
the officer selects progress status "Selesai" without uploading a repair proof photo file
the officer clicks the "Perbarui Status Penanganan" button
the system rejects the WorkOrder status update
the system displays an error message "Foto bukti penyelesaian perbaikan wajib diunggah untuk menutup laporan"

name: UC-F Temporary Repair and Follow-up Visit
description:
As a PUPR Road Inspector supervising a repair
I want to mark a repair as temporary and schedule a follow-up visit
So that the ticket is only completed after the permanent repair is checked

elements.name: Inspector records a temporary repair with a follow-up schedule (Happy Path)

steps.name: report "LAP-2026-0001" is in "Dalam Proses" status assigned to road inspector "Budi Santoso"
the officer checks "Perbaikan sementara"
the officer fills the follow-up visit date with the date 7 days from today
the officer inputs progress notes "Ditambal sementara dengan cold mix, menunggu hotmix"
the officer clicks the "Perbarui Status Penanganan" button
the ticket "REP-2026-00341" keeps the status "Dalam Proses"
the follow-up visit date is shown on the "Tugas Lapangan" page
the citizen timeline of "LAP-2026-0001" shows "Kunjungan lanjutan dijadwalkan"

elements.name: Ticket cannot be completed before the follow-up visit is recorded (Negative Path)

steps.name: report "LAP-2026-0001" is "Dalam Proses" with a pending follow-up visit 7 days from today
the officer selects progress status "Selesai" and uploads repair proof photo "selesai_0001.jpg"
the officer clicks the "Perbarui Status Penanganan" button
the system rejects the WorkOrder status update
the system displays an error message "Catat kunjungan lanjutan terlebih dahulu sebelum menyelesaikan tiket"

elements.name: Follow-up visit date in the past is rejected (Negative Path)

steps.name: report "LAP-2026-0001" is in "Dalam Proses" status assigned to road inspector "Budi Santoso"
the officer checks "Perbaikan sementara"
the officer fills the follow-up visit date with yesterday's date
the officer clicks the "Perbarui Status Penanganan" button
the system displays a warning message "Jadwal kunjungan lanjutan harus tanggal setelah hari ini"
no follow-up visit is saved for "REP-2026-00341"

elements.name: Ticket is completed after the follow-up visit is recorded early (Happy Path)

steps.name: report "LAP-2026-0001" is "Dalam Proses" with a pending follow-up visit 7 days from today
the officer records the follow-up visit today with notes "Hotmix permanen sudah dipasang"
the follow-up visit is saved even though its scheduled date has not arrived
the officer selects progress status "Selesai" and uploads repair proof photo "selesai_0001.jpg"
the officer clicks the "Perbarui Status Penanganan" button
the system updates the WorkOrder status and report status of "LAP-2026-0001" to "Selesai"

elements.name: Rescheduling replaces the single active follow-up visit (Boundary Path)

steps.name: report "LAP-2026-0001" is "Dalam Proses" with a pending follow-up visit 7 days from today
the officer reschedules the follow-up visit to the date 14 days from today
"REP-2026-00341" has exactly one active follow-up visit, dated 14 days from today
the earlier schedule is kept in the status history as "Kunjungan lanjutan dijadwalkan ulang"
the "Tugas Lapangan" page shows only the date 14 days from today

name: Assigning a Penilik Jalan
description:
In order to memastikan tiket yang telah diverifikasi ditangani oleh petugas yang tepat
As a Admin
I want to menugaskan Penilik Jalan

elements.name: Successfully Assigning a Penilik Jalan

steps.name: I have verified ticket "REP-2026-00341"
I select the ticket
I see the handling priority "Urgent" along with a list of available Penilik Jalan in "Wilayah Gubeng"
I select "Budi Santoso" as the Penilik Jalan
I see the ticket status change to "Ditugaskan"

elements.name: No Penilik Jalan Available

steps.name: I see ticket "REP-2026-00360" located in "Wilayah Benowo"
I attempt to make an assignment and find no available Penilik Jalan in that region
I see the ticket marked as "Menunggu Penugasan"

name: Viewing the Infrastructure Priority Dashboard
description:
In order to memantau sebaran dan prioritas kerusakan infrastruktur secara menyeluruh
As a Admin
I want to melihat dashboard prioritas infrastruktur

elements.name: Monitoring the Damage Distribution Map

steps.name: I see 245 active Work Orders in the system
I open the "/Dashboard" page
I see a damage distribution map with color gradation according to severity
I see a list of tickets sorted from highest Risk Score, "REP-2026-00341 (8.4)"

elements.name: Filter Produces No Data

steps.name: I apply the filter "Wilayah: Wonokromo, Status: Selesai, Kategori: Retak Permukaan"
I see the message "Tidak ada laporan sesuai filter"

name: UC-I Report Status Notification
description:
As a Reporting Citizen
I want to receive and view a list of notifications within the app whenever my report status changes
So that I can directly know the latest updates without checking tickets manually

elements.name: Citizen views notification list and marks message as read (Happy Path)

steps.name: the citizen has a new unread notification for report "LAP-2026-0001"
the citizen opens the "Notifikasi" menu and clicks the unread notification item
the system updates the notification read status to read
the system redirects the citizen to the detail progress page of report "LAP-2026-0001"

name: UC-I Notification Delivery and Resend
description:
As a PUPR Admin
I want every status notification to record its delivery status and be resent when it fails
So that citizens are not left without news about their report

elements.name: Notification is delivered on the first attempt (Happy Path)

steps.name: the notification delivery channel failure rate is "0"
the admin assigns road inspector "Budi Santoso" to ticket "REP-2026-00341"
the citizen "0812xxxxxxx" receives a notification for report "LAP-2026-0001"
the notification delivery status is "Terkirim" after 1 attempt

elements.name: Failed notification is retried automatically and listed as failed (Negative Path)

steps.name: the notification delivery channel failure rate is "1"
the admin assigns road inspector "Budi Santoso" to ticket "REP-2026-00341"
the ticket "REP-2026-00341" has status "Ditugaskan"
the notification for report "LAP-2026-0001" has delivery status "Gagal" after 3 automatic retries
the notification delivery attempt count is 4 (1 initial send + 3 retries)
the notification appears on the "Notifikasi Gagal" page with the "Kirim Ulang" button

elements.name: Admin resends a failed notification (Happy Path)

steps.name: a notification for report "LAP-2026-0001" has delivery status "Gagal"
the notification delivery channel failure rate is "0"
the admin opens the "Notifikasi Gagal" page
the admin clicks the "Kirim Ulang" button for report "LAP-2026-0001"
the system displays the message "Notifikasi berhasil dikirim ulang"
the notification delivery status is "Terkirim"
the notification no longer appears on the "Notifikasi Gagal" page

elements.name: Head of Division cannot resend notifications (Negative Path)

steps.name: a notification for report "LAP-2026-0001" has delivery status "Gagal"
the head of division opens the "Notifikasi Gagal" page
the head of division does not see the "Kirim Ulang" button
a direct resend request by the head of division is rejected with status 403

name: UC-I Live Notification Badge and In-page Toast
description:
As a Reporting Citizen
I want the notification badge and a toast to appear without refreshing the page
So that I know right away when my report status changes

elements.name: Badge and toast update without refreshing the page (Happy Path)

steps.name: the citizen "0812xxxxxxx" is on the "Beranda" page with notification badge "1"
the admin assigns road inspector "Budi Santoso" to ticket "REP-2026-00341"
within one polling interval the notification badge shows "2" without a page reload
a toast containing "LAP-2026-0001" appears on the page

elements.name: Browser notification is shown when the citizen grants permission (Happy Path)

steps.name: the citizen "0812xxxxxxx" is on the "Beranda" page
the browser notification permission is "granted"
the admin assigns road inspector "Budi Santoso" to ticket "REP-2026-00341"
within one polling interval a browser notification with title "Status laporan LAP-2026-0001 diperbarui" is shown

elements.name: Permission denied falls back to the in-page toast only (Negative Path)

steps.name: the citizen "0812xxxxxxx" is on the "Beranda" page
the browser notification permission is "denied"
the admin assigns road inspector "Budi Santoso" to ticket "REP-2026-00341"
within one polling interval a toast containing "LAP-2026-0001" appears on the page
no browser notification is shown and no script error is logged

elements.name: Unread-count endpoint is only for the logged-in citizen (Negative Path)

steps.name: I am not logged in
I request the unread notification count endpoint
the response status is 401 and contains no notification data
the admin requests the unread notification count endpoint
the response status is 403

name: UC-J Citizen Rating and Review System for Handling
description:
As a Reporting Citizen whose report has been successfully repaired
I want to provide a star rating (1-5) and review comments on the quality of road repairs
So that the PUPR Department receives feedback evaluating the field repair team's performance

elements.name: Citizen successfully submits rating and review for a Completed report (Happy Path)

steps.name: the citizen opens the details of report "LAP-2026-0001" with status "Selesai" and no existing rating
the citizen selects a "5" star rating score and writes review "Perbaikan sangat cepat dan rapi"
the citizen clicks the "Kirim Ulasan" button
the system saves the evaluation to the Rating table
the system displays a confirmation message "Terima kasih atas ulasan dan penilaian Anda"

elements.name: Citizen submits review without selecting a star rating (Negative Path)

steps.name: the citizen opens the details of report "LAP-2026-0001" with status "Selesai" and no existing rating
the citizen leaves the star rating option blank and clicks the "Kirim Ulasan" button
the system rejects the review submission
the system displays a warning message "Silakan pilih bintang rating (1-5) terlebih dahulu"

name: User Authentication
description:
In order to mengakses sistem sesuai dengan peran saya
As a user (warga/petugas)
I want to melakukan login

steps.name: I am on the "/Login" page
I have a registered account with phone number "0812xxxxxxx"

I am directed to the "/Beranda" page

name: UC-L Export Infrastructure Performance Report
description:
As a Head of Division (Kepala Bidang)
I want to view and download the infrastructure handling performance recap
So that I can evaluate how long each handling stage takes and the risk statistics per rayon region

elements.name: Head of Division views and downloads the performance report (Happy Path)

steps.name: the head of division opens the "Laporan Kinerja Infrastruktur" page
the head of division selects the period "2026-10-01" to "2026-10-31" and region "Semua Wilayah"
the head of division clicks the "Tampilkan" button
the system displays the performance recap for region "Wilayah Gubeng" with 4 tickets
the average duration of stage "Inspeksi Lapangan" is "1.1 hari"
the oldest active ticket is "REP-2026-00298" in stage "Inspeksi Lapangan"
the head of division downloads the "Unduh Rekap Wilayah (CSV)" file
the downloaded CSV file contains the recap row of "Wilayah Gubeng"

elements.name: No performance data in the selected period (Negative Path)

steps.name: the head of division opens the "Laporan Kinerja Infrastruktur" page
the head of division selects the period "2025-01-01" to "2025-01-31" and region "Semua Wilayah"
the head of division clicks the "Tampilkan" button
the system displays the message "Tidak ada data kinerja pada periode yang dipilih"
the download buttons are not shown

name: UC-L Performance Charts
description:
As a Head of Division (Kepala Bidang)
I want to see the performance recap as charts that follow the period and region filter
So that I can spot trends and bottlenecks faster than by reading tables

elements.name: Charts show the same numbers as the tables (Happy Path)

steps.name: the head of division opens the "Laporan Kinerja Infrastruktur" page
the head of division selects the period "2026-10-01" to "2026-10-31" and region "Semua Wilayah"
the head of division clicks the "Tampilkan" button
the charts "Tren Tiket Masuk vs Selesai per Minggu", "Distribusi Prioritas", "Rata-rata Durasi per Tahap" and "Rekap per Wilayah" are displayed
the "Distribusi Prioritas" chart shows "Urgent" 2, "Tinggi" 2, "Borderline" 1 and "Rendah" 0
the weekly trend chart totals 5 incoming and 1 completed tickets
every chart value equals the matching value in the recap tables

elements.name: Charts follow the region filter (Happy Path)

steps.name: the head of division opens the "Laporan Kinerja Infrastruktur" page
the head of division selects the period "2026-10-01" to "2026-10-31" and region "Wilayah Benowo"
the head of division clicks the "Tampilkan" button
the "Rekap per Wilayah" chart shows only "Wilayah Benowo" with 1 ticket
the "Distribusi Prioritas" chart shows "Tinggi" 1

elements.name: Closed tickets are shown separately and not counted as completed (Alternative Path)

steps.name: ticket "REP-2026-00341" has been closed with reason "Laporan tidak valid"
the head of division shows the performance report for "2026-10-01" to "2026-10-31" and region "Semua Wilayah"
the "Ditutup" section shows 1 ticket for reason "Laporan tidak valid"
the total ticket count is 4 and the completed count is still 1
the completion rate is calculated from 4 tickets, not 5
the "Distribusi Prioritas" chart shows "Urgent" 1, "Tinggi" 2, "Borderline" 1 and "Rendah" 0

elements.name: Empty period shows no charts (Negative Path)

steps.name: the head of division opens the "Laporan Kinerja Infrastruktur" page
the head of division selects the period "2025-01-01" to "2025-01-31" and region "Semua Wilayah"
the head of division clicks the "Tampilkan" button
the system displays the message "Tidak ada data kinerja pada periode yang dipilih"
no chart is displayed
